The source plate map marks British Columbia, Manitoba and Ontario as requiring front plates; nonrequired provinces can still show plates on vehicles. New Brunswick has older imagery from before 2019 and Newfoundland/Labrador commercial vehicles require plates. These are moderate visual-occurrence estimates, not complements of the no-front-plate observation or measured frequencies.
